data.name: Recording
data.comment: recording toolbar's window title; title of recording notifications

data.name: SystemAudioLevel
data.comment: level meter

data.name: MicrophoneLevel
data.comment: level meter

data.name: MuteMicTip
data.value: Silence the microphone in the recording (system audio keeps recording)

data.name: PushToTalkTip
data.value: Push to talk: the microphone is only recorded while this key is held (set in Settings › Hotkeys)

data.name: SoundSettingsTip
data.value: Volume and mute for each sound source

data.name: DrawOnScreenTip
data.value: Draw on the screen (the drawing is recorded); Esc or Done ends it

data.name: StopTip
data.value: Stop and save (or press the recording hotkey)

data.name: NoiseSuppressionTip
data.value: RNNoise: removes steady noise such as fans, hum and typing; heard at once

data.name: KeystrokesShownTip
data.value: Keystrokes are shown. Click to stop showing them for a while (e.g. to type something private).

data.name: KeystrokesHiddenTip
data.value: Keystrokes are hidden. Click to show them again.

data.name: Talking
data.comment: push to talk: its key is held

data.name: HoldToTalk
data.comment: {0}: a key name such as F13

data.name: SoundWithNote
data.comment: {0}: what sound is recorded; {1}: why some is missing

data.name: SoundSystem
data.comment: in the saved notification's details

data.name: StoppedSaving
data.value: {0} What was recorded is being saved.
data.comment: {0}: why the recording stopped

data.name: StillSaving
data.value: The last recording is still being saved. Try again in a moment.

data.name: TooSmall
data.value: That area is too small to record ({0}x{1}).

data.name: NameAndMoreParts_one
data.comment: {0}: how many more parts; {1}: the file name of the first

data.name: NameAndMoreParts_other
data.comment: {0}: how many more parts; {1}: the file name of the first

data.name: EncoderAndSound
data.comment: {0}: encoder; {1}: the sound recorded

data.name: FramesSkipped
data.value: {0:P0} of the frames were skipped because encoding couldn't keep up. A lower frame rate or a smaller area helps.

data.name: InterruptedMessage_one
data.value: A recording wasn't saved because CashGear Capture closed while recording. Click here (or use the tray menu) to save what was recorded.

data.name: InterruptedMessage_other
data.value: Recordings weren't saved because CashGear Capture closed while recording. Click here (or use the tray menu) to save what was recorded.

data.name: NothingWritten
data.value: The recording started {0} stopped before anything could be written. It was removed.
data.comment: {0}: date and time

data.name: LastSecondMissing
data.value: The last second or so before the interruption is missing.

data.name: ListSeparator
data.comment: between file names

data.name: NotRecovered
data.value: The recording could not be recovered

data.name: KeptTryAgain
data.value: {0} It is kept; try again from the tray menu.
data.comment: {0}: the error

data.name: AddingOverlaysTo
data.comment: {0}: file name

data.name: NoMetadata
data.value: {0} has no metadata file, so its clicks and keys aren't known. Recordings get one when Settings › Overlays › Save a metadata file is on.

data.name: OverlaysDrawnNote
data.value: The overlays are drawn as Settings › Overlays has them now, into a new file next to the recording; the recording itself isn't changed.

data.name: DrawingTitle
data.comment: title of the drawing layer's window

data.name: MeterSilent
data.comment: a level meter's tooltip

data.name: MeterPeak
data.comment: {0}: the held peak level

data.name: InFolder
data.comment: a notification's last line; {0}: folder

data.name: StartedAt
data.comment: {0}: length; {1}: date and time

data.name: StateRecording
data.comment: screen reader: the state of the recording (the red dot)

data.name: StatePaused
data.comment: screen reader: the state of the recording (the grey square)

data.name: ElapsedRecording
data.comment: screen reader: the recording toolbar's clock while recording; {0} is the time recorded, e.g. 1:23

data.name: ElapsedPaused
data.comment: screen reader: the recording toolbar's clock while paused; {0} is the time recorded, e.g. 1:23
